decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully records J_PWR_SIGNAL and its D+ and D- assignments on pins 5 and 6; no additional update or removal is required.
Assigning SDA0 and SCL0 to interboard connector pins does not change the I2C cable-length, bus-speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location requirements.
The source specifies connector types and electrical pin assignments but does not change connector orientation, physical placement, battery access, or mounting-hole clearance.
The interboard power and signal connector pinout does not change the selected SK6812 LED family or its GPIO13 data assignment.
J_PWR_POWER and J_PWR_SIGNAL are interboard connectors; the source does not change the separate JST-PH battery connector, its three pins, or its part number.
The interboard connector pinout does not alter the J_BAT NTC terminal or the AXP2101 battery thermal-protection behavior.
The source does not change the charge-status display method, GPIO13 assignment, or absence of a dedicated charge LED interface.
